title: Roots of Childhood
author: Mahima Gantayat
text:
Look how time has passed
The place where our childhood blossomed
Now remains only in memories.

The siblings who once played here
Have now left their childhood behind
Embracing responsibilities.

The breeze still carries old memories,
The water retains its sweetness
The greenery of the trees
Once filled our lives with colors.

It`s shadows used to
Protect us from sorrow.

With time we too have changed
Some bonds were left beneath this tree
In search of new friends.
